question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 8.
solution:
The correct answer is 'is.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the subject **'cold'** is singular and the first part of the sentence is in the Present tense.

 
 
• यहां subject 'cold', एकवचन है और वाक्य का पहला भाग वर्तमान काल में है।
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'is.'
 
• The correct phrase: *It is known that a cold **is** caused by one of the number .......*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In English there are three articles: a, an, and the.
 
• Articles are used before nouns or noun equivalents and are a type of adjective.
 
• The definite article (the) is used before a noun to indicate that the identity of the noun is known to the reader.
 
• The indefinite article (a, an) is used before a noun that is general or when its identity is not known. There are certain situations in which a noun takes no article.* *
